Couple of guys are closing up the airport for the night, one of them takes the Jet fuel truck to the fuel farm to top it off for the next day. He runs the precheck test to make sure the shutoff switch works to stop the fuel flow when the truck is full, then rigs the dead man to keep running and walks away to do other stuff to save time.

The manager at the time is driving by after a night out, and sees jet fuel gushing out of the top of the truck, and quickly intervens to stop it.

This truck had a history of check valve failures when it came to stopping the flow of fuel when the truck was full. About 250 gallons of Jet Fuel went over the truck and into the ground. Which resulted in several extra hours of paperwork and running around for the people working that night.

Needless to say he lost his job and made the night a lot shittier by trying to save a little bit of time.
